daily_scan.notes: Friday scan. All 18 Sunday-only umbrellas (stage_label 'Approved / marketed' with molecule_class exactly ['non_incretin'] -- the admin's 2026-09-29 rule) skipped again, counted as throttled. Of the remaining 30 non-Sunday-only umbrellas, 25 are mid-throttle this run (checked yesterday 2026-10-01, now only 1 KST day later -- due again Sunday/Monday per the 3rd-day cadence), also counted as throttled. The other 5 (last_updated within 21 days, so never throttle-eligible) got a full breadth-first query on their single most distinctive alias: ascendis-transcon-novo (TransCon Semaglutide), nanexa-pharmashell-semaglutide (PharmaShell), peptron-pt403 (PT403), samsung-bioepis-g2gbio-gb7001 (GB-7001) and zealand-petrelintide (Petrelintide). Four of the five reconfirmed existing documentation with no new findings. The exception: peptron-pt403 -- a second, independently bylined outlet (Asia Business Daily/view.asiae.co.kr) corroborated the Sept 28 MTN-sourced Korean patent registration covering semaglutide and tirzepatide GLP-1 formulations, clearing the confirmed-source bar for that event and adding a PT404 dosing-interval detail (monthly or once-every-2-months); logged as a new finding (f-2026-10-01-001, confidence upgraded to confirmed), current_status.last_updated advanced to 2026-10-01, molecule_class left unchanged at ["semaglutide"] (PT404 is still a distinct, unlicensed candidate asset, not part of this record's own formulated pipeline). Track B1: all 14 fixed watchlist rows queried (En/Kr per class plus cross-class and other_incretin rows) -- all already-tracked programs reconfirmed, no new finding. Code harvest surfaced ~19 code-pattern strings (PT403/PT404, GB-7001, IVL3021/3024, AUL009, MET-233i, ABBV-295, ZP8396, HM15275, AMG133/MariTide, NN1213, CT-G32, DD14/DD07/DD02S/DD03/MET06, DD15) -- all resolved to already-tracked aliases or known decoys except DD15 (D&D Pharmatech's Metsera-licensed injectable GLP-1/GIP/GCG triple agonist, 'Tri-G'), which was unknown and used this run's one bounded code query; resolved into a new candidate (cand-2026-10-02-001) rather than a known program. AMG133/MariTide (Amgen) and NN1213 (a Novo Nordisk academic amylin-analog research code) surfaced only as comparator/academic mentions in existing evidence, not as fresh disclosures this run, so neither was queued -- flagging AMG133/MariTide in the run report as a possible registry gap worth a deliberate look, since Amgen is not currently tracked anywhere in the 48 umbrellas despite being a major once-monthly engineered-peptide program. Rotation list: queried ct-g32, abbv-295, pt404 and lilly-camurus (4 rows, resuming after 'biote-cn121154792a' and wrapping to the start) -- all four reconfirmed existing documentation with nothing new; repeating the standing proposal that the admin remove 'abbv-295' and 'biote-cn121154792a' from the rotation list now that both are tracked candidates. One existing ready_for_promotion candidate's UniSphero/Samik Pharmaceutical thymosin alpha-1 patent (cand-2026-09-17-001) resurfaced via a B1 cross-class query but matched evidence already on file (patent No. 10-3012843) -- no new append. B3 cheap pass (2/2 searches spent): re-searched the 2 near_bar candidates furthest from their last check, i2o Therapeutics (cand-2026-09-20-002) and Precision Antibiotics (cand-2026-09-07-001) -- both found only material already on file, no new dated event for either, promotion_bar.evidence rewritten on both, no status change. Date math aged all 17 unresolved candidates (16 carried in plus the new DD15 candidate). Stall rule applied for the first time this registry has triggered it: cand-2026-09-02-002 (Samchundang) and cand-2026-09-02-003 (SpiderCore) both reached 30+ days with 6-7 follow-up checks and no evidence dated after their own creation date, so both moved pending -> stalled, flagged recommend reject-or-snooze. A third candidate meeting the same mechanical age/checks/no-new-evidence criteria, cand-2026-09-02-007 (CSPC ZhongQi, a merge case at fuzzy_match 0.58 that already clears all four promotion-bar conditions), was deliberately NOT stalled -- stalling would misrepresent a fully-evidenced merge-decision case as a thin, go-nowhere one; left as pending with the existing merge-case flag, a judgment call documented in the run's commit message for the admin. No domain returned EGRESS_BLOCKED this run; two direct WebFetches succeeded (hitnews.co.kr, en.sedaily.com, both newly added/confirmed under source_health as 'ok') while koreabiomed.com, dailypharm.com and view.asiae.co.kr (already on the blocked/search-only list) were reached via search snippet only.

weekly_sweep.notes: Track B2 class- and code-aware structural sweep, ~35 queries: (1) per-molecule clinicaltrials.gov once-monthly queries for all four named classes -- all four still return only weekly/daily programs, no new registrations; (2) per-molecule Google Patents query paired with a depot/sustained-release term -- semaglutide/tirzepatide hits all resolved to already-tracked assignees (Mapi Pharma, G2GBio, Owl Bio/AUL018), retatrutide and amylin queries returned only octreotide/generic amylin prior art, and one tirzepatide delivery-system filing (WO2024134493A1) could not be attributed to a named assignee even after a second query, so it was dropped rather than queued thin; (3) conference accepted-abstract indices for ADA/EASD/ObesityWeek -- an ADA 2026 poster (466-P, monthly semaglutide microsphere in ZDF rats) traced by co-author overlap to Owl Bio's already-tracked AUL009/ExTenna program; EASD 2026 Ascletis/Lilly abstracts and Pfizer's berobenatide ADA coverage all already-tracked; ObesityWeek 2026 abstract portal open, nothing new; (4) KIPRIS/USPTO/WIPO sustained-release/depot CPC sweep -- folded into (2), no new untracked program; (5) full watchlist rotation list (5 rows: abbv-295, pt404, lilly-camurus, biote-cn121154792a, ct-g32) -- abbv-295 and biote-cn121154792a are now resolved into candidates cand-2026-09-22-001 and cand-2026-09-20-001 respectively and should be removed from the rotation list (admin action, runs never edit the watchlist); pt404, lilly-camurus and ct-g32 (Celltrion, still no disclosed dosing interval, primate tox underway, IND targeted H1 2027) all reconfirmed existing documentation with no new dosing-interval disclosure; (6) all 13 Sunday-only rows (S1-S9 class/language variants, S10-S13 per-molecule clinicaltrials.gov) -- all quiet/reconfirming, matching the 2026-09-14 gap-test finding that these are structurally low-yield, except S5 (semaglutide CN) which reconfirmed CSPC's own SYH9017 code, already a tracked candidate; (7) KOSDAQ 기술특례상장 pipeline -- no new LAI-specific entrant, only already-tracked Samik Pharmaceutical (candidate) and Dongkook (existing umbrella) CPHI coverage; (8) university tech-transfer / VC-deal-database sweep -- surfaced a major new dated event for an already-promoted umbrella: Novo Nordisk signed a EUR 1.165B global exclusive license (up to 5 PharmaShell programs, monthly/quarterly targets, announced 2026-09-25) with Nanexa, logged as finding f-2026-09-25-001 on nanexa-pharmashell-semaglutide (current_status.partner and last_updated updated accordingly; nanexa.com added to source_health as blocked). No other new untracked program or candidate-worthy entity surfaced this run. Code harvest across all B2 results surfaced no unknown codes needing the bounded 3-query resolution path. Track B3 weekly deep pass covered all 16 previously-unresolved candidates in order (ready_for_promotion first, then near_bar pending, then the rest of pending -- no watch/stalled candidates exist yet, so the every-4th-sweep step did not apply): the 4 ready_for_promotion candidates (Alveus/ALV-100, Prolynx, Samik/UniSphero, AbbVie-Gubra/ABBV-295) each got a fresh re-search -- Alveus, Samik and AbbVie/Gubra each surfaced a further corroborating/additional dated event (Phase 2 PRESERVE trial; a third distinct UniSphero patent; Gubra's $50M milestone payment) strengthening an already-cleared bar, Prolynx found nothing new; all 4 remain ready_for_promotion awaiting admin resolution, none newly escalated this run. Of the 7 near_bar pending candidates, none cleared second_dated_event this run (Samchundang, SpiderCore, Precision Antibiotics, Appel Sauce Studios, Alteogen and Beijing Biote all reconfirmed the same single dated event or found only unrelated/out-of-scope company news; i2o Therapeutics' rejection-based second-event judgment call remains open for the admin). Of the 5 remaining pending candidates, no material change: the two CSPC merge-case candidates (cand-2026-09-02-007, cand-2026-09-13-002) and the Mapi Pharma Cariprazine merge case (cand-2026-09-06-001) all reconfirmed their existing single-source/merge-case status; Korea BioNC/ProAptec found only unrelated (gout-drug) company news; Hengrui ribupatide reconfirmed weekly/oral-only formulations, still recommended for admin reject-with-reason. No candidate was created, escalated, stalled, merged, rejected or snoozed this run beyond what is detailed above.
